description:
Outcome: A household applies for the coming season with up to three preferences, from brief.md First version must 1
Scope: Phone form, 0–3 distinct valid plot preferences, one application per household/season, server submission timestamp, receipt and coordinator review list; accessible transition from pending verification to application. Excludes: allocation, post-submission preference editing and map
Acceptance: Valid submission gets receipt; invalid/fourth preference rejected; repeat/concurrent submission preserves original application and timestamp; verification request is not application; receipt explains timing and waiting-list consequences; verified new household can apply
Behaviour: No upcoming-season state, pending membership explanation, loading, accessible validation and retries retaining input
Verification: New-household phone E2E, preference validation and concurrent/idempotent submission tests. Prerequisites: T-003, T-004. Assumptions: zero preferences permitted by up to three; configured season calendar
title: Coming-season household applications
